newsitem.title: UK: UK parliament to debate economy, Europe on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: UK parliament to debate economy, Europe on Tuesday.

text.p: Parliament will debate the economy and Europe next Tuesday, the fifth and final day of the traditional week-long debate that follows the Queen's Speech, Speaker Betty Boothroyd announced.
She told the House of Commons that other subjects would be discussed as follows:
-- Thursday, May 15: work, welfare, education and health.
MPs also approved a motion by Leader of the House of Commons Ann Taylor naming Conservative MPs Sir Alan Haselhurst and Malcolm Lord and Labour MP Michael Martin as deputy speakers.
Haselhurst will be Boothroyd's deputy. As Chairman of Ways and Means, he will be responsible for the committee stages of bills when they are debated on the floor of the Commons.
He also takes the chair during the budget speech.
